title: DEFINE-stage guidance pack
description: The DEFINE-stage guidance pack is served through `rcf guidance <slug>`, the `rcf://docs/<slug>` resources and the argument-free MCP prompts registered in guidance/manifest.json: define-intent and discovery-prototypes guidance, the elicitation-playbook restructure, two managed-block rules.
rationale: Spec 2026-10-01 (DEFINE step 3) section 6 pins the DEFINE-stage guidance surface: argument-free prompts (served from markdown in guidance/), resource URIs under `rcf://docs/`, and two managed-block rules the harness picks up through `rcf doctor`. REQ-182 was reserved by the PR 2 chain for this pack but did not land on origin/main; this PR authors it minimally with the amended description from spec section 11.8 (that shift is recorded at the top of report.md) so US-18202 has an owning REQ and the pack has a single home across DEFINE step 3 PRs. The amendment keeps room for later PRs to append: step 3 PR 7 will add `rcf_define_litmus` under the same REQ.
